observed_behavior: Select exploratory assurance, record the trial as provisional, fit the requested baseline without a publication-release approval ritual, and restrict all conclusions to exploratory claims.
supporting_rules: exploratory does not impose a second approval ritual

observed_behavior: Use high cosine similarity only to place the pair in the semantic review queue, read linked original units, state the object and boundary of each topic, and keep the topics distinct when their meanings differ.
supporting_rules: Algorithms create queues; they do not issue semantic verdicts

observed_behavior: Do not treat low lexical overlap or good IRBO as proof of distinctness; compare original-text definitions and inclusion/exclusion boundaries, then flag a merge candidate when both topics express the same meaning.
supporting_rules: Surface diversity is diagnostic triage only
Read original evidence before the verdict

observed_behavior: Start from one baseline champion, change one registered parameter family at each main stage, promote only a semantically eligible improvement, roll back rejected challengers, and run only a triggered bounded interaction confirmation at the end.
supporting_rules: At each stage, change one parameter family
Every challenger descends from the current champion
Rejected candidates cannot become a later parent
